edit_instruction: Enhance the vibrancy of the salad greens and carrots, and add a subtle moist sheen to the surface of the steak to make it appear more appetizing.
Change the translucent white plastic of the kite to a solid bright blue color.
Enhance the vibrancy and crispness of the lettuce and other ingredients in the opened sandwich, making it appear fresher and more appetizing.
Remove the sunglasses from the man on the far left wearing the red jacket, revealing his eyes with a natural and pleasant expression.
Change the overcast sky to a clear blue sky, casting bright sunlight across the street and buildings, and adding distinct shadows.
Apply a subtle fill light to the faces of the people playing the video game in the foreground and midground to improve their visibility.
Remove the various papers, notes, and signs from the cork board and surrounding wall area behind the chef, reducing visual clutter.
Remove the plastic bag of greens from the upper right corner of the image to simplify the background.
Remove the purple bucket with its contents and the white trash can from the floor, seamlessly extending the tiled floor underneath.
Remove the water bottle from the left countertop, all food packaging and miscellaneous items from the right countertop, and the cereal box and mug from atop the refrigerator.
